f.title: Keep auditable records of clinical and animal experience and studies with the new drug
f.statement: Where a manufacturer has received a notice of compliance for a new drug (new drug submission, extraordinary use new drug submission, abbreviated new drug submission, abbreviated extraordinary use new drug submission or a supplement), it shall establish and maintain records, in a manner that enables an audit to be made, respecting animal or clinical experience, studies, investigations and tests conducted by the manufacturer or reported to it by any person concerning that new drug.
f.applicability: New drugs for which the manufacturer has received a notice of compliance (NDS, EUNDS, ANDS, abbreviated EUNDS or a supplement)
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up

f.title: Keep auditable records of scientific literature reports on the new drug
f.statement: The manufacturer shall establish and maintain auditable records respecting reports from the scientific literature, or the bibliography therefrom, that are available to it concerning that new drug.
f.applicability: New drugs for which the manufacturer has received a notice of compliance (NDS, EUNDS, ANDS, abbreviated EUNDS or a supplement)
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Data integrity & records

f.title: Keep auditable records of product property studies and of substitution or mixing
f.statement: The manufacturer shall establish and maintain auditable records respecting experience, investigations, studies and tests involving the chemical or physical properties or any other properties of the new drug, and any substitution of another substance for that new drug or any mixing of another substance with that new drug.
f.applicability: New drugs for which the manufacturer has received a notice of compliance (NDS, EUNDS, ANDS, abbreviated EUNDS or a supplement)

f.title: Keep auditable records of labelling errors and lot changes or deterioration
f.statement: The manufacturer shall establish and maintain auditable records respecting any error in the labelling of the new drug or in the use of the labels designed for it, and any bacteriological or any significant chemical or physical or other change or deterioration in any lot of the new drug.
f.applicability: New drugs for which the manufacturer has received a notice of compliance (NDS, EUNDS, ANDS, abbreviated EUNDS or a supplement)
f.processes: Cross-functional handoffs; Case processing & follow-up; Data integrity & records

f.title: Keep auditable records of lot specification failures and unusual failure in efficacy
f.statement: The manufacturer shall establish and maintain auditable records respecting any failure of one or more distributed lots of the new drug to meet the specifications established in the submission or supplement, and any unusual failure in efficacy of that new drug.
f.applicability: New drugs for which the manufacturer has received a notice of compliance (NDS, EUNDS, ANDS, abbreviated EUNDS or a supplement)
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Signal detection; Data integrity & records

f.title: Retain C.08.007 new drug records for at least seven years
f.statement: The manufacturer shall retain the records respecting the information referred to in C.08.007(1) for at least seven years from the day on which they were established.
f.applicability: New drugs for which the manufacturer has received a notice of compliance (NDS, EUNDS, ANDS, abbreviated EUNDS or a supplement)

f.title: Furnish summaries of clinical, literature and property records on the Minister's request
f.statement: No manufacturer shall sell a new drug unless it has, with respect to all its previous sales of that new drug, furnished to the Minister, on receipt of a request from the Minister, a summary of a record respecting any information referred to in C.08.007(1)(a) to (c) (clinical and animal experience, literature reports, product properties).
f.applicability: New drugs for which the manufacturer has received a notice of compliance (NDS, EUNDS, ANDS, abbreviated EUNDS or a supplement)

f.title: Furnish immediately summaries of substitution, labelling-error and deterioration records
f.statement: No manufacturer shall sell a new drug unless it has furnished to the Minister a summary of a record respecting any information referred to in C.08.007(1)(d) to (f) (substitution or mixing, labelling errors, change or deterioration of a lot) immediately on establishing the record.
f.applicability: New drugs for which the manufacturer has received a notice of compliance (NDS, EUNDS, ANDS, abbreviated EUNDS or a supplement)

f.title: Furnish summaries of lot failure and unusual failure in efficacy records within 15 days
f.statement: No manufacturer shall sell a new drug unless it has, with respect to all its previous sales of that new drug, furnished to the Minister a summary of a record respecting any information referred to in C.08.007(1)(g) or (h) (distributed lots failing specifications, unusual failure in efficacy) within 15 days after the day on which the manufacturer established the record.
f.applicability: New drugs for which the manufacturer has received a notice of compliance (NDS, EUNDS, ANDS, abbreviated EUNDS or a supplement)
f.processes: Submission operations; Case processing & follow-up; Reporting policy

f.title: Adhere to the plan for an extraordinary use new drug
f.statement: Where a manufacturer has received a notice of compliance for an extraordinary use new drug submission, an abbreviated extraordinary use new drug submission or a supplement to either, it shall adhere to the plan referred to in subparagraph C.08.002.01(2)(b)(ix).
f.applicability: Extraordinary use new drugs (EUNDS, abbreviated EUNDS or supplement)
f.processes: Risk management & minimisation; Epidemiology / safety studies

f.title: Provide an annual report on use with critical analysis of safety for extraordinary use new drugs
f.statement: The manufacturer of an extraordinary use new drug shall, before the first day of October in each year and whenever requested by the Minister for the purposes of assessing the safety and effectiveness of the drug, provide a report on the use of the drug, including a critical analysis of any available updated information respecting the drug's safety and effectiveness.
f.applicability: Extraordinary use new drugs (EUNDS, abbreviated EUNDS or supplement)
f.processes: Aggregate reporting; Benefit–risk review; Submission operations
